lines: Red and blue across the windshield
From the television in the den
Your chair’s still there beside the table
You just don’t come around again
Twenty years of borrowing tools
And pulling each other from the mud
Now you need to know which side I’m on
Before you’ll call me someone you love
**Pre-Chorus**
You said, “It ain’t a hard question—
You’re with us or you ain’t.”
I said, “Anything that simple
Ought to scare us both to death.”
Lay the hard proof on the table
Let it name whatever it names
If it puts my people in the wrong
I don’t get to look away
Don’t wrap your fear in colors
Then tell me that it’s proof
I’m exhausted by people asking me to choose a tribe
When I’m trying to choose the truth
I have worn my share of jerseys
I have cheered a crooked call
Saw the replay, knew damn well
And still defended it through it all
I’ve moved the posts, excused the bastards
Called conviction what was pride
Then swallowed that four-word humiliation:
“Goddamn it—you were right.”
Don’t mistake me for a man
Who thinks the answer splits in two
Sometimes the blood is on one hand
Sometimes one account is true
Fair don’t mean we share the blame
So every liar gets a turn
It means staying with the evidence
When it’s your own house that burns
Lay the hard proof on the table
Let it name whatever it names
If it puts my people in the wrong
I don’t get to look away
Don’t wrap your fear in colors
Then tell me that it’s proof
I’m exhausted by people asking me to choose a tribe
When I’m trying to choose the truth
Church-lot gravel Sunday morning
Talk radio bleeding through the doors
A preacher names the latest devils
While the plate collects for war
Flags snap hard above the windows
Of stores that haven’t sold in years
Men in suits buy better lighting
Then sell us back our cheapest fears
At supper, someone lifts a phone
And half the family disappears
One small thumb erases forty years
Because a screen said, “Enemy here”
Everybody in the cheap seats
Tears their neighbor black and blue
While the owners toast above the field
And bet on what we’ll do
We used to have a saying
When the room got mean and still:
“If we’re not careful,
things could get western.”
A little cowboy understatement.
Good for half a nervous grin.
Funny—
right until nobody laughs
and somebody locks the door.
Lay the hard proof on the table
Let it name whatever it names
If it puts my people in the wrong
I will look it in the face
No jersey—
No borrowed enemies—
No flag can make a lie come true
I’m exhausted by people asking me to choose a tribe
When I’m trying to choose the truth
I’m exhausted by people asking me to choose a tribe
When I’m trying to choose the truth
**Breakdown / Outro**
You can keep the color.
You can keep the crowd.
You can keep the easy answer
Everybody’s chanting loud.
Whatever truth requires of me—
That’s mine to fucking do.
Choose what you can answer for.
